title: Chorus product configuration
description: Product name and desktop update checks, read by the desktop app.

name.description: Display name of the product, also used in window titles.

updates.description: How the desktop app checks for updates.

firstCheckSeconds.description: Seconds after start before the first update check.

laterHours.description: Hours before a version the user postponed with Later is offered again.

feeds.description: Update feeds, tried in order until one answers. {releasesRepository} is replaced with the releases repository in CI; a feed that still has a placeholder is left out of the build.

url.description: Address of the electron-updater generic feed that holds the update info files.

page.description: Release page opened when the app cannot install updates itself.
